req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept POST requests to create tasks without a description field. This implies that the description field is optional. The test suite will include a positive test case to verify that a task can be created without a description, a negative test case to ensure that invalid inputs are rejected, and a boundary test case to check the system's behavior with edge-case inputs.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that omits the description field.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and completed status.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
assert "description" not in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_task_with_invalid_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that has an empty title.
expected: The response contains a validation error message for the title field.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "ensure this value has at least 1 characters"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_length_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that has a title of maximum allowed length.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and completed status.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
assert "description" not in response.json()
